The index measures year-over-year change, where 100 means Celsius Point of Sale Growth was equal to the same month last year. Values above 100 indicate growth and values below 100 indicate decline: for example, 103 = 3% more spend than year prior, 97 = 3% decline from year prior. The index is measured by Carbon Arc's point-of-sale receipt panel using in-store and online purchases captured via receipt-scanning and rewards apps, matched to the same period of the prior year. The panel updates daily as new data arrives.

At listing, its members are Netflix, Hulu: Stream shows & movies, Disney+, Paramount+, Peacock TV: Stream TV & Movies, Max: Stream HBO, TV, & Movies, ESPN: Live Sports & Scores, each weighted 1/7. Each constituent index is 100 when its measured app downloads equals the same month of the previous year; the array averages these indices. An array level of 103 means the constituents' average year-over-year growth is 3%, and 97 means their average decline is 3%.

KXCCAPRICEICE.rules_primary: If the official CARB Current Auction USD Settlement Price for CARB Joint Auction #48 is greater than or equal to the official ICE settlement for August 2026 California Carbon Allowance Vintage 2026 Future on August 19, 2026, the market resolves to Yes.
KXCCAPRICEICE.rules_secondary:
CARB Leg: Use the uniform-price allowance price, expressed in USD/tCO2e, resulting from the sale of allowances in the Current Auction component. This figure strictly excludes the Advance Auction Settlement Price, any Allowance Price Containment Reserve sale price, and any secondary-market pricing. If the Current Auction is undersubscribed and clears at the Auction Reserve Price, that reserve price serves as the Settlement Price.

ICE Leg: Use the official ICE settlement for the August 2026 California Carbon Allowance Vintage 2026 Future for trade date August 19, 2026; if none is published for that trade date, use the most recent prior official ICE settlement.

Resolution: Compare both values exactly as published, to the cent, without rounding. The market resolves Yes if the CARB Current Auction Settlement Price is greater than or equal to the ICE settlement price, and No if it is strictly less. In the event that Joint Auction #48 is canceled, postponed, or CARB fails to publish the Summary Results Report by 11:59 PM PT on September 30, 2026, the market resolves to No.
KXCCAPRICEICE.title: Will the USD Settlement Price for the Current Auction of the August 19, 2026 CARB Joint Auction #48 settle at or above the official August 19, 2026 ICE settlement price for the August 2026 California Carbon Allowance Vintage 2026 Future?

KXBEERARRAY.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
KXBEERARRAY.rules_primary: If the Carbon Arc Light beer point of sale spend array index (November 2026) for November 2026 is above 84, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXBEERARRAY.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this market, determination will resolve on the Carbon Arc Light Beers Array value for the full month covered by this market, as recorded by Kalshi at 11:59 p.m. ET on the 2nd calendar day after the end of that month. For example, the value for August is recorded at 11:59 p.m. ET on September 2. Later corrections or revisions will not affect the recorded value.

The reference is Carbon Arc's published full-month Light Beers Array level: https://www.carbonarc.co/prisms?prism=2a4a9d31-f3d0-46b5-ba55-ecc422745898&entity=Light+Beers. The underlying metric is convenience-store point-of-sale spend. The array is the equally weighted arithmetic mean of its constituent year-over-year indices. At listing, its members are Miller Lite, Bud Light, Coors Light, each weighted 1/3. Each constituent index is 100 when its measured convenience-store point-of-sale spend equals the same month of the previous year; the array averages these indices. An array level of 103 means the constituents' average year-over-year growth is 3%, and 97 means their average decline is 3%.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the underlying companies. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

For purposes of this market, determination will resolve on the Carbon Arc Nicotine Products Array value for the full month covered by this market, as recorded by Kalshi at 11:59 p.m. ET on the 2nd calendar day after the end of that month. For example, the value for August is recorded at 11:59 p.m. ET on September 2. Later corrections or revisions will not affect the recorded value.

The reference is Carbon Arc's published full-month Nicotine Products Array level: https://www.carbonarc.co/prisms?prism=760cbe4e-2cdc-4139-8285-d97a6de34cb9&entity=Nicotine+Products. The underlying metric is convenience-store point-of-sale spend. The array is the equally weighted arithmetic mean of its constituent year-over-year indices. At listing, its members are Zyn, Velo, on!, Rogue, each weighted 1/4. Each constituent index is 100 when its measured convenience-store point-of-sale spend equals the same month of the previous year; the array averages these indices. An array level of 103 means the constituents' average year-over-year growth is 3%, and 97 means their average decline is 3%.

The index measures year-over-year change, where 100 means Affirm Credit Card Spend was equal to the same month last year. Values above 100 indicate growth and values below 100 indicate decline: for example, 103 = 3% more spend than year prior, 97 = 3% decline from year prior. The index is measured by Carbon Arc's aggregated U.S. credit and debit card transaction panel, matched to the same period of the prior year. The panel updates daily as new data arrives.

The underlying metric is convenience-store point-of-sale spend. The array is the equally weighted arithmetic mean of its constituent year-over-year indices. At listing, its members are Red Bull, Monster Energy Drinks, Celsius, Alani Nu, C4 Energy, Rockstar Energy, each weighted 1/6. Each constituent index is 100 when its measured convenience-store point-of-sale spend equals the same month of the previous year; the array averages these indices. An array level of 103 means the constituents' average year-over-year growth is 3%, and 97 means their average decline is 3%.

KXPUBLIXCC.rules_primary: If the Carbon Arc Publix Credit Card Spend (November 2026) for November 2026 is above 98.5, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXPUBLIXCC.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this market, determination will resolve on finalized Carbon Arc values recorded at 11:59 p.m. ET on the 4th calendar day after the end of the month covered by this market. For example, finalized Carbon Arc values for August will be recorded at 11:59 p.m. ET on September 4th.

The index measures year-over-year change, where 100 means Publix Credit Card Spend was equal to the same month last year. Values above 100 indicate growth and values below 100 indicate decline: for example, 103 = 3% more spend than year prior, 97 = 3% decline from year prior. The index is measured by Carbon Arc's aggregated U.S. credit and debit card transaction panel, matched to the same period of the prior year. The panel updates daily as new data arrives.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with Publix. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

KXGASARRAY.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
KXGASARRAY.rules_primary: If the Carbon Arc Gas station credit card spend array index (November 2026) for November 2026 is above 112.5 , then the market resolves to Yes.
KXGASARRAY.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this market, determination will resolve on the Carbon Arc Gas Station Spend Array value for the full month covered by this market, as recorded by Kalshi at 11:59 p.m. ET on the 4th calendar day after the end of that month. For example, the value for August is recorded at 11:59 p.m. ET on September 4. Later corrections or revisions will not affect the recorded value.

The reference is Carbon Arc's published full-month Gas Station Spend Array level: https://www.carbonarc.co/prisms?prism=4c7ec991-0913-4e7f-9fca-c525d44a483b&entity=Gas+Station+Spend. The underlying metric is credit card spend. The array is the equally weighted arithmetic mean of its constituent year-over-year indices. At listing, its members are ExxonMobil Corporation, BP (British Petroleum), Royal Dutch Shell, Chevron, each weighted 1/4. Each constituent index is 100 when its measured credit card spend equals the same month of the previous year; the array averages these indices. An array level of 103 means the constituents' average year-over-year growth is 3%, and 97 means their average decline is 3%.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the underlying companies. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

KXSODAARRAY.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
KXSODAARRAY.rules_primary: If the Carbon Arc Soda point of sale spend array index (November 2026) for November 2026 is above 98, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXSODAARRAY.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this market, determination will resolve on the Carbon Arc Soda Brands Array value for the full month covered by this market, as recorded by Kalshi at 11:59 p.m. ET on the 2nd calendar day after the end of that month. For example, the value for August is recorded at 11:59 p.m. ET on September 2nd. Later corrections or revisions will not affect the recorded value.

The reference is Carbon Arc's published full-month Soda Brands Array level: https://www.carbonarc.co/prisms?prism=c6eb419d-6f74-41c4-ab20-6c34602f593f&entity=Soda+Brands. The underlying metric is convenience-store point-of-sale spend. The array is the equally weighted arithmetic mean of its constituent year-over-year indices. At listing, its members are Coca-Cola, Pepsi, Mountain Dew, Dr. Pepper, Sprite, each weighted 1/5. Each constituent index is 100 when its measured convenience-store point-of-sale spend equals the same month of the previous year; the array averages these indices. An array level of 103 means the constituents' average year-over-year growth is 3%, and 97 means their average decline is 3%.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the underlying companies. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

KXCCAVSICE.rules_primary: If the official CARB Current Auction USD Settlement Price for CARB Joint Auction #49 is greater than or equal to the official ICE settlement for November 2026 California Carbon Allowance Vintage 2026 Future on November 18, 2026, the market resolves to Yes.
KXCCAVSICE.rules_secondary:
CARB Leg: Use the uniform-price allowance price, expressed in USD/tCO2e, resulting from the sale of allowances in the Current Auction component. This figure strictly excludes the Advance Auction Settlement Price, any Allowance Price Containment Reserve sale price, and any secondary-market pricing. If the Current Auction is undersubscribed and clears at the Auction Reserve Price, that reserve price serves as the Settlement Price.

ICE Leg: Use the official ICE settlement for the November 2026 California Carbon Allowance Vintage 2026 Future for trade date November 18, 2026; if none is published for that trade date, use the most recent prior official ICE settlement.

Resolution: Compare both values exactly as published, to the cent, without rounding. The market resolves Yes if the CARB Current Auction Settlement Price is greater than or equal to the ICE settlement price, and No if it is strictly less. In the event that Joint Auction #49 is canceled, postponed, or CARB fails to publish the Summary Results Report by January 1, 2027 at 2:59 AM EST, the market resolves to No.
KXCCAVSICE.title: Will the USD Settlement Price for the Current Auction of the November 18, 2026 CARB Joint Auction #49 settle at or above the official November 18, 2026 ICE settlement price for the November 2026 California Carbon Allowance Vintage 2026 Future?

KXCOFFEEARRAY.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
KXCOFFEEARRAY.rules_primary: If the Carbon Arc Coffee chain foot traffic array index (November 2026) for November 2026 is above 112, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXCOFFEEARRAY.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this market, determination will resolve on the Carbon Arc Coffee Chains Array value for the full month covered by this market, as recorded by Kalshi at 11:59 p.m. ET on the 7th calendar day after the end of that month. For example, the value for August is recorded at 11:59 p.m. ET on September 7. Later corrections or revisions will not affect the recorded value.

The reference is Carbon Arc's published full-month Coffee Chains Array level: https://www.carbonarc.co/prisms?prism=ca2222e8-3be0-4883-a103-96d37c4aeb76&entity=Coffee+Chains. The underlying metric is foot traffic. The array is the equally weighted arithmetic mean of its constituent year-over-year indices. At listing, its members are Dutch Bros. Coffee, Starbucks, each weighted 1/2. Each constituent index is 100 when its measured foot traffic equals the same month of the previous year; the array averages these indices. An array level of 103 means the constituents' average year-over-year growth is 3%, and 97 means their average decline is 3%.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the underlying companies. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

For purposes of this market, determination will resolve on the Carbon Arc Rideshare Apps Array value for the full month covered by this market, as recorded by Kalshi at 11:59 p.m. ET on the 7th calendar day after the end of that month. For example, the value for August is recorded at 11:59 p.m. ET on September 7. Later corrections or revisions will not affect the recorded value.

The reference is Carbon Arc's published full-month Rideshare Apps Array level: https://www.carbonarc.co/prisms?prism=2fff36c3-6355-4b68-a914-9bd5013f185a&entity=Rideshare+Apps. The underlying metric is app downloads. The array is the equally weighted arithmetic mean of its constituent year-over-year indices. At listing, its members are Uber - Request a ride, Lyft, each weighted 1/2. Each constituent index is 100 when its measured app downloads equals the same month of the previous year; the array averages these indices. An array level of 103 means the constituents' average year-over-year growth is 3%, and 97 means their average decline is 3%.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the underlying companies. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

KXCHILISCC.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this market, determination will resolve on finalized Carbon Arc values recorded at 11:59 p.m. ET on the 4th calendar day after the end of the month covered by this market. For example, finalized Carbon Arc values for August will be recorded at 11:59 p.m. ET on September 4th.

The index measures year-over-year change, where 100 means Chili's Credit Card Spend was equal to the same month last year. The index is measured by Carbon Arc's aggregated U.S. credit and debit card transaction panel, matched to the same period of the prior year. The panel updates daily as new data arrives.

Reference: https://www.carbonarc.ai/prisms?prism=9705ecb2-d711-4f67-b67e-de444ed2490f&entity=Rhode

Tracks Carbon Arc's published monthly TikTok Shop revenue growth index for Rhode, from its Total Revenue panel. It measures the brand's TikTok Shop revenue relative to the same month one year earlier, not its worldwide revenue, units sold or revenue share. An index of 100 means unchanged year over year; 103 means 3% growth and 97 means a 3% decline. Carbon Arc uses a sample of activity rather than every transaction.
